breaking.change: project.ogt is removed as project configuration and discovery. Ordinary og-project.json (version 1) is the sole project marker and name/engine/look authority; project.ts exports defineProject configuration. Hosts receive structured ProjectStartup, not OGT text. Cook consumes the restricted TS index/evaluator/reference graph, and watch refreshes bootstrap, generated types and import dependencies on edits. No old-project fallback is provided.
breaking.fix: Create a new-format project with og new. Keep engine/name/look only in og-project.json, put configuration in project.ts, and use canonical content refs. Replace OGT startup strings with checked og project --json startup data. Capture scripts are a project.ts screens map; storyFunctions declares ordered parameters and typed returns. Unmigrated scene/prefab/look/Yarn dialogue retain their one physical cooked ID: only project refs use base/<assets-relative-stem>, bound through actual scan results before ProjectStartup is emitted. Existing scene references and game og.load IDs remain unchanged; no lookup fallback or OGT bridge is added. Duplicate canonical TS/scanned identities fail. Each domain cutover moves its outputs to canonical IDs and deletes its binding with its author parser: P1 look, P2 dialogue, P3 scene/prefab.

breaking.change: The scaffold payload and release overlay replace project.ogt with og-project.json and project.ts. defaultRoots discovers that JSON marker. readLook and readAudioChoices read the checked og project --json snapshot instead of parsing project OGT, and now require the matching installed og executable on PATH or OG_BIN. The creationBlock OGT serializer and its create-game re-export are removed. Signatures and return shapes of defaultRoots, payload, installed, mount, summary, readLook, readAudioChoices, presetLook and artBrief are unchanged; presetLook and artBrief still need no executable.

Install the matching released og before invoking project briefs (or set OG_BIN). Use parseCreationInput/inferCreationChoices/resolveCreationChoices objects as project.ts defineProject create input, or call og new, instead of creationBlock. Do not execute TS in the platform.
